title: EXE-00-05: AI Verification & Evaluation Investigation
description: Investigate AI-generated pull requests, architectural recommendations, and deployment plans in the Visual AI Investigation Workspace. Detect phantom npm packages, fabricated RFC documentation citations, inverted boolean conditions, and multi-candidate comparative rankings without writing code.
instructions: Step into the role of an AI Verification Analyst. Inspect 4 diagnostic cases across the AI Response Inspector, Hallucination Detection Panel, Verification Evidence Panel, Context Gap Analyzer, and Evaluation Scoring Matrix. Complete all forensic evaluations and submit solution achieving >= 90% score.
objective: Demonstrate practical engineering rigor when evaluating AI outputs by identifying hallucinations, detecting inverted logic, verifying compiler & registry ground truth, diagnosing context gaps, and objectively scoring candidate responses.
expected_outcome: Complete forensic AI verification audit achieving >= 90% score across visible (40%) and hidden (60%) test suites, advancing competency AIE-00 to Verified state.
success_criteria: Accurately flag phantom package @auth/jwt-auto-verify-v2, fabricated RFC citation, inverted rate limiter logic, missing table schema context, and rank Candidate B > Candidate C > Candidate A.
